content:
Last weekend, Apple TV made several announcements at San Diego Comic-Con, including the premiere date for the fourth season of "Silo."

"Silo" season 4 will premiere in the summer of 2027 and will be the show's final season.

"Silo" season 3 is currently airing (you can stream it here), with new episodes dropping weekly until September 4.

However, at last weekend's San Diego Comic-Con, Apple not only shared updates on other sci-fi series but also delivered a major surprise for fans of "Silo."

"Silo" season 4 will premiere next summer, bringing the entire series to a close.

Below is the announcement posted by Apple TV on X:

In the streaming era, it's become increasingly common for shows to take several years between new seasons, and this is especially true for expensive sci-fi series—"Silo" being a prime example.

However, Apple has been actively greenlighting new seasons well in advance, hoping to speed up the return of some of its shows. In the case of "Silo," seasons 3 and 4 were developed simultaneously and filmed back-to-back.

"Silo" still has six weeks of new episodes left to air, but after this season wraps up, viewers won't have to wait long for season 4.

What are your impressions of "Silo" season 3? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.

Apple TV's monthly subscription service is priced at US$12.99, and is also available through the Apple One bundle.
